run.task: Recover the lost catalog soft-delete / restore / trash-bin work (all 74 tracked files from the 2026-10-18 21:38 stash) and prove the trash endpoints work

criteria.statement: Given a soft-deleted category exists, when GET /api/dashboard/categories/deleted is called, then it returns a paged trash-bin listing instead of 'Category not found'.
criteria.notes: Live against the recovered app on :8081 — HTTP 200, message 'Deleted categories retrieved', paged content. Before the recovery the same path resolved to GET /dashboard/categories/{slug} and answered 'Category not found'.

criteria.statement: Given a soft-deleted category, when PATCH /api/dashboard/categories/{id}/restore is called, then deleted_at is cleared and the row reappears in ordinary queries and leaves the trash bin.
criteria.notes: Live: create -> soft delete -> appears in trash -> PATCH restore 200 'Category restored' -> absent from trash -> readable via GET /dashboard/categories/{slug}.

criteria.statement: Given a soft-deleted category, when DELETE /api/dashboard/categories/{id}/permanent is called, then the row is removed and no longer appears in the trash bin.
criteria.notes: Live: soft delete -> DELETE /{id}/permanent 204 -> absent from the trash listing; verified in PostgreSQL that the probe row is gone.

criteria.statement: Given the recovered worktree, when the controllers are inspected, then every catalog the stash covered exposes GET /deleted, PATCH /{id}/restore and DELETE /{id}/permanent, plus journal and products.
criteria.notes: 42 trash-bin routes across 13 controllers (the 10 above plus categories, journal-categories, promo-codes, shipping-zones).

criteria.statement: Given the restored files, when ./mvnw compile runs, then the project builds with no errors, proving the restored modified files are consistent with the already-on-disk new files.
criteria.notes: Required one repair: the stash left two @Query annotations on findAllDashboard (non-repeatable annotation on line 100), which aborted javac and cascaded into 414 Lombok 'cannot find symbol' errors. Removed the stale first annotation; the pairings fetch-join the stash intended is kept. Build must run under JDK 21.0.2 (.mise.toml), not JDK 27.

criteria.statement: Given the pre-recovery worktree snapshot, when the preserved files are compared, then docker-compose.yml, pom.xml, Permission.java, the migrations and the message bundles are byte-identical, Role.java keeps MODERATOR's DASHBOARD_READ (stash) and AUDIT_READ (worktree) and keeps CUSTOMER's USER_READ/USER_UPDATE, and a CUSTOMER can still use /api/addresses.
criteria.notes: Role.java merged three-way: MODERATOR gained DASHBOARD_READ (stash) while keeping AUDIT_READ (worktree). The stash's removal of CUSTOMER's USER_READ/USER_UPDATE was deliberately NOT applied — AddressController gates the whole customer address book on those, so applying it 403s /api/addresses (adversarial review CRITICAL, fixed). Live: a CUSTOMER token reads /api/addresses 200.
